name: WdHorizontalLineWidthType
description: Specifies how Word interprets the width (length) of the specified horizontal line.

constants.name: wdHorizontalLinePercentWidth
constants.description: Word interprets the width (length) of the specified horizontal line as a percentage of the screen width. This is the default value for horizontal lines added with the AddHorizontalLineStandard method. Setting the PercentWidth property on a horizontal line sets the WidthType property to this value.

constants.name: wdHorizontalLineFixedWidth
constants.description: Microsoft Word interprets the width (length) of the specified horizontal line as a fixed value (in points). This is the default value for horizontal lines added with the AddHorizontalLine method. Setting the Width property for the InlineShape object associated with a horizontal line sets the WidthType property to this value.
